Name: Stardew Voices 2.0.3.5 - Bug Fix Patch
Author: HawaiianGamer
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][img width=866]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313644-807176853.png[/img][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This is an unofficial, complete release of [/color][b][color=#00ffff]Stardew Voices 2.0.3[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8], originally created by [/color][b][color=#00ffff]Shannon Hobby[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8]. It includes the original voice audio together with fixes for [/color][color=#9900ff][b]Stardrop[/b][/color][color=#d4d4d8] installation, dialogue lookup, and incorrect sound cue IDs.[/color]
[size=3]
[color=#d4d4d8]You do [/color][b][color=#d4d4d8]not[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] need to download the original mod separately. Everything needed from Stardew Voices is included in this download.[/color][/size]

[size=3][color=#d4d4d8][img width=494]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790314133-605790918.png[/img][/color][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]You can help with dialogue playback errors!! Please screenshot the SMAPI console window right after a line fails to play as well as the chat box window of what they said! Explain whose line it was, what Season and Day it was, time of day as much detail as you can provide helps narrow down what line it was and to figure out what the error was.
[b][i]Example Console Error:[/i][/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b][i][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790314407-716376951.png[/img][/i][/b][/color]

[img width=285]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313878-561946539.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fixes the missing [b]Stardew Voices.xgs[/b] and audio-bank errors caused by Stardrop's installed-mod directory junction.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Supports both Stardrop installations and normal SMAPI installations.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Adds schedule dialogue lookup for all 12 supported characters.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Fixes valid schedule lines being incorrectly reported as missing event-end dialogue.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Corrects verified English dialogue cue names that did not match the names in the character sound banks.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Includes fixes for verified character, gift, event, generic, and festival dialogue mismatches.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b][img width=211]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313903-826444965.png[/img][/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Add aliases for certain dialogue lines when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1083]Anthro Characters Continued[/url] is installed.[/color][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This will not change what the voice recording originally had recorded.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Does not affect use of the mod if this mod is not installed, just allows compatibility with mod mentioned above.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[img width=267]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313931-2017841809.png[/img]
[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.3.2 or later[/url][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url] — used to configure language and individual character volume settings in-game.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[img width=362]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313953-1148948378.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Remove or disable any existing installation of Stardew Voices. Only one copy should be installed.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Download this mod and install it through Stardrop normally.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through Stardrop.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list]
[img width=382]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313972-1336989475.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Close Stardew Valley and SMAPI.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Remove any existing [b]StardewVoices[/b] folder from your game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the [b]StardewVoices[/b] folder from this archive into the game's [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
Do not install this alongside the original Stardew Voices release. This is a complete replacement and already contains the original assets.[/color][/size]

[img width=189]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790313991-897937203.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Remove the previous [b]StardewVoices[/b] folder before installing a newer version. The included manifest uses this community release's Nexus page for SMAPI update notifications.[/color][/size]

[img width=318]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790314004-646443551.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Three English schedule references do not have a cue with the same ID in their character sound bank:[/color][/size]

[list]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Alex: [b]Sun[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Haley: [b]rain[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Shane: [b]marriage_Mon_animal_shop_2[/b][/color][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][color=#D4D4D8]
Those recordings could not be verified, so this release does not substitute unrelated audio for them.[/color][/size]

[img width=381]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790314015-354782964.png[/img]

[size=3][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shannon Hobby[/b] created Stardew Voices, its original code and dialogue data, and all included voice audio. Please visit and support the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22550]original Stardew Voices page[/url].

This unofficial release is distributed under the permissions published on the original Nexus Mods page, which allow bug fixes, improvements, and reuse of the original assets when the original creator is credited.

The original permissions prohibit uploading these files to other websites. Please do not redistribute this release outside Nexus Mods without the required permission from the original creator.[/color][/size]

[img width=477]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52730/52730-1790314028-2078634154.png[/img]

[size=3][b][i][color=#d4d4d8]This mod was developed with AI simply for me to be able to experience the mod without having to modify my [/color][color=#9900ff]Stardrop[/color][color=#d4d4d8] installation, reinstalling all my other mods manually so the file system bug can be fixed. This release is only intended to allow other users having issues with the latest version of the mod, have a simple install process.[/color][/i][/b]

[b][color=#ff0000]PLEASE SUPPORT THE ORIGINAL DEVELOPERS.[/color][/b]

[color=#d4d4d8]The bug investigation, DLL patch, dialogue corrections, and release materials were produced with [/color][color=#ff00ff]OpenAI Codex[/color][color=#d4d4d8] assistance and reviewed against the original mod files and sound-bank cue names. No new voices or audio were generated for this release.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]The Nexus Mods [/color][b][color=#ff00ff]AI-Generated Content[/color][/b][color=#d4d4d8] tag is applied because the DLL patch contains generated code.[/color][/size]
